what: Renderer linter regex still matches ANSI-C replacement syntax the plan says is safe
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed grep pattern ends at bare $ and therefore flags existing safe ${out//$'\n'/$'\n' } usage, while also lacking explicit harness coverage for the mentioned $arr[0] variant
suggested_fix: Tighten the regex so the replacement must start with a variable form such as $name or ${name}, not $'...'; add fixture cases for ANSI-C pass and $arr[0] fail

what: Flag-signature linter does not pin the real multi-line invocation shape
scenario_or_breakage: The plan mentions continuation lines but the harness list has no multi-line fixture, so an implementation could pass tests while missing the current write-run-params.sh drift pattern
suggested_fix: Specify logical-command assembly for trailing-backslash lines and add a fixture mirroring the script line followed by flags on continuation lines

what: Flag-signature linter scope is inconsistent and broader than the minimum-change contract
scenario_or_breakage: The behavior says SKILL.md plus references/*.md, the sibling docs say skills/**/*.md, and Makefile/pre-commit invoke the linter without narrowing argv, leaving the implemented scan surface ambiguous
suggested_fix: Pick one scope and state it identically in behavior, docs, and hook rationale; for SIMPLE prefer skills/*/SKILL.md unless reference-file coverage is required by an acceptance criterion
